items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: The thing that Billy wrote and I never learned was that thing that Duke played.

ctx.x: His mother named him Billy and Duke did an album on him. I'm trying to find out what tune did you think was a song, or a suite.
The thing that Billy wrote and I never learned was that thing that Duke played. And I was talking about it the other day.
